about.title: About Me
about.description: I build scalable enterprise and SaaS applications with Angular and .NET Core. I focus on clean architecture, secure role-based access (RBAC), workflow automation, and performance—delivering maintainable systems that support complex business processes.

summary.title: Mitul Navapara
summary.description: Senior Full Stack Developer with 8 years of experience building scalable enterprise and SaaS applications. Expertise in Angular (v7+ to latest), TypeScript, RxJS/NgRx, ASP.NET Core, RESTful APIs, PostgreSQL, and MySQL, with strong background in Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, RBAC, workflow automation, performance optimization, Agile delivery, and mentoring development teams.

responsibilities: Led development of enterprise recruitment, insurance verification, healthcare, and e-commerce platforms using Angular and .NET Core.
Architected scalable APIs, workflow automation, and role-based access control (RBAC) solutions to improve operational efficiency and system security.
Drove application modernization initiatives, including Angular upgrades and performance optimizations, while mentoring developers and enforcing coding standards.

experience.position: Tech Lead / Senior Full Stack Developer
responsibilities: Led frontend architecture and technical direction for enterprise project management and operational management platforms.
Designed and implemented scalable RBAC frameworks, dashboards, and workflow-driven modules supporting complex business processes and multiple user roles.
Established development standards, reusable component architecture, and mentoring practices that improved team productivity and code quality.
Developed secure healthcare and gaming platforms using Angular and .NET Core, delivering scalable and user-focused solutions.
Integrated payment gateways, reporting systems, and role-based access controls to enhance platform functionality and security.
Optimized application performance and collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project delivery.
Contributed to the development of education and community management platforms using Angular and .NET technologies.
Built dashboards, analytics, real-time tracking, and communication modules to improve user engagement and operational efficiency.
Developed scalable features across web and mobile applications while strengthening full-stack development expertise.
